title: Confirm the published LCS score on the final numeric checker
description: Rebuild and compare the exact released Commons Text LCS score, upstream source and shared-row control on all 225 ordered pairs. Prove the published JAR at the original array, unwind and 120-second checker bounds and retain its full output.
expected: Retain the actual bounded checker statement, independent results, measurements and any first diagnostic.

steps.name: Check the verdict, raw bound and all three JVM tables
steps.run: python3 -c 'import json,sys,hashlib; from pathlib import Path; r=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()); assert r["native"]["verdict"]=="verified" and r["native"]["bounds"]=={"maxArrayLength":4,"unwind":18}; assert r["native"]["outcomeSha256"]==hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(); assert {k:(v["pairs"],v["disagreements"]) for k,v in r["artifacts"].items()}=={"release":(225,0),"rebuilt":(225,0),"shared-row":(225,44)}' examples/308-commons-text-longest-common-subsequence/records/numeric-checker-transfer.json examples/308-commons-text-longest-common-subsequence/records/numeric-checker-native.json
